create_video_processor: create an Ernie4_5_VLMoeVideoProcessor instance with custom patch_size, temporal_patch_size, and draw_on_frames settings
build_video_preprocess_pipeline: build a video preprocessing pipeline that samples frames, draws timestamps, and converts videos to normalized patches
sample_video_frames: sample frames from a video given a VideoMetadata object with total_num_frames and fps
render_timestamp_on_frames: render timestamp strings on video frames using a specified font with black text and white border
load_video_processor_from_hub: load an Ernie4_5_VLMoeVideoProcessor from a Hugging Face Hub model ID including its font file
